resources.string: Locks the screen over any app (videos, games, video calls) so little fingers can\'t press anything. The screen stays on, and only a parent\'s fingerprint can unlock it.
Needed so the lock can sit on top of the app your child is using.
Unlocking needs a fingerprint enrolled on this device. Only enroll fingers belonging to parents.
Shows a status notification while the lock is active.
✗ This device has no supported fingerprint sensor

Fastest way: open the app your child will use, swipe down, and tap the \"Toddler Lock\" Quick Settings tile. Or tap \"Lock in %1$d seconds\" here and switch to the app.\n\nTo unlock: press and hold the lock badge in the corner, then touch the fingerprint sensor.
Screen locked\nHold the 🔒 then use your fingerprint to unlock
Tap to unlock with your fingerprint
Switch to the app your child will use
